Name: Ladder Light
Author: Tocseoj
Description:
Just adds a glow to any ladders or shafts while in the mines. No configuration yet, but plan to add some options where it twinkles,
rather than just stay a static light.

This is my first mod.
Feedback is welcome. Thanks!
